title: Edgar Mitchell said no astronaut ever saw a UFO in space
summary: Clas Svahn tells of Edgar Mitchell said no astronaut ever saw a UFO in space, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yeah, the thing he was very adamant

plain: A Swedish UFO researcher named Clas Svahn says on Jesse Michels's podcast that the astronaut Edgar Mitchell was very firm on one point. According to Svahn, Mitchell insisted that no astronaut had ever seen a UFO in space, even though he was interested in the subject.
